title: Deck Builder
selected_by_owner: Owner approved the 15 map-authoring HTML cycles, corrected the program ID to MMHT and directed the first cycle.

in_scope: Standalone editing and measurement of vehicle and ship deck map geometry
Editable ship and rover samples, stable feature IDs, optional portable references, undo and reopen
Map export and preservation of older tester workspaces
boundaries: Owner-approved map authoring only. Ship and vehicle operations, base construction, farming, extraction, ecology simulation and other gameplay engines retain their owner-domain scope. Map features may store typed references for later integration.
Standalone artifact confirmation is separate from installed product integration and owner playtest feedback.

evidence.validation: Focused execution of the actual generated tester bundle using JSDOM and native Canvas. Ship and rover samples loaded. Hull resizing, undo/redo, level switching, manual compartment and shaft drawing, overlap accounting, areas in ft² and m², feature references, save/reopen, PNG, and 12N compatibility passed.
evidence.example: A 20 × 15 ft compartment is 300 ft² drawn and 275 ft² usable with a 5 × 5 ft shaft.
evidence.boundaries: Offline test harness only. Installed product sessions and real-device testing remain unverified.

next_action: Owner review of Deck Builder. Use feedback for MMHT-02 once selected.
successor_rule: Requires owner direction to start the next standalone review cycle.

last_material_progress.evidence: MMHT-01 artifact, checksum and executed focused checks.

stop_reason.evidence: The standalone Deck Builder HTML was saved and passed the focused workflow checks for MMHT-01.
